subtitle: Lesson 24 · Inner Product Spaces, Unitary & Hermitian Operators

eyebrow: The Projection Operator, as an Outer Product
caption: A matrix built from two vectors — applied to any vector, it keeps only the 'amount of |0>' and zeroes out the rest.
The |1> part is zeroed out; the result is exactly the amplitude <0|psi> times |0>.

steps.label: |0><0| and |1><1| isolate each measurement outcome's component
steps.sub: <0|psi> is the amplitude; its squared magnitude is the probability

steps.label: Only an orthonormal basis keeps probabilities summing to 1
steps.sub: Otherwise the projections would double-count part of the state
